run_format_mmimdb_dataset: run the script to format the MMIMDB dataset from a given root path into JSONL split files
create_jsonl_splits: create train, validation, and test JSONL split files from the MMIMDB dataset directory
filter_news_genre: filter out samples with the News genre label when formatting the MMIMDB dataset
select_longest_plot: select the longest plot summary for each movie sample using numpy argmax on plot lengths
review_format_mmimdb_dataset: review the format_mmimdb_dataset function that converts MMIMDB JSON files into structured JSONL split files
